profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Renew is on a mission to make renting more meaningful and valuable for everyone. 

One hundred million renters go through the lease renewal process every year. We’re modernizing the way they live and move within apartment networks - and how properties define retention. A win-win for both.

We help apartment owners and operators transform the resident renewal process and power retention on a portfolio-wide basis. We help renters seamlessly renew their lease or navigate finding another home within a their community's portfolio.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: ZEVV gets chefs and restaurant brands into mobile dining with the world’s first eco-friendly vending vehicle powered by intelligent software, enabling food brands and entrepreneurs to improve food access for all.

positions.title: First Software Engineer and Platform Manager
positions.description:
- Hired as the first engineer
- Architected Jetty's backend systems and delivered our go-to-market product from conception to launch in 6 months, through seed funding (led by Ribbit) and Series A (led by Valar) and Series B (led by Khosla)
- Designed and implemented a performant / scalable underwriting engine for computing insurance prices in milliseconds 
- Designed and implemented Jetty’s foundational private AWS networking infrastructure, VPN, bastion-2FA, high-availability that satisfies regulatory / SOC compliance requirements 
- Key decision maker in recruiting processes and org design (defined responsibilities, processes, and roles for the Engineering team; recruited key hires, accountability structures, and set precedence for cultural norms)

positions.title: First Software Engineer and Technical Platform Manager
positions.description:
- Hired as the first engineer to work with the founder / CEO and our leadership team of health care experts to architect initial systems with HIPPA compliance
- Led product development and engineering from seed funding through Series A (Oak Capital) and Series B (Google Ventures)
- Continued to play a hybrid role in coding and managing the platform technology team (recruiting, project managing)
- Oversaw the engineering team as it quickly grew from 1 to over 20 (and the company to around 200 employees)

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description:
- Founding engineer
- Helped with decks to raise seed / series A funding led by Formation 8 (Joe Lonsdale of Palantir) 
- Led product development including design of technical architecture and implementation of the data engine and client web platform. Helped win contracts with some of the largest brand name tech companies

positions.title: Resident Software Engineer
positions.description: - Led technical implementation of various software projects for external clients

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
- Supported proprietary research technology in the critical path for generating market signals for trading on $150 billion AUM (largest hedge fund in the world)
- Refactored critical data transformation processes to improve computational efficiency and lower support costs
- Managed an operations team and L1/L2 support
